description: This PHP source file defines the ViewEmployeeAttendanceController class within the OrangeHRM framework. The class extends AbstractVueController and manages the pre-render logic for viewing an employee's attendance, including fetching employee data, access permissions, and configuring UI components based on request parameters.

classes.name: ViewEmployeeAttendanceController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling pre-render logic related to viewing employee attendance details or summaries based on query parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with relevant data and access controls before rendering. Checks for 'employeeId' and 'date' query parameters, verifies user permissions, fetches employee data, and configures the UI component accordingly.
